人们发现RNA结构可以调节诺如病毒生命周期的多个阶段,包括翻译和复制,并且它们的操纵使得体内合理衰减成为可能。 [10.1038/d41573-026-00154-x]

news.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 与冷冻蛏子相关的疾病引发了 诺如病毒 警报。加泰罗尼亚当局发现了可疑批次并将其撤回,而欧洲警报证实贝类中存在 诺如病毒 基因型 GI 和 GII。 [news-bb873d5875b587c5]
9 名食客在西班牙塔拉戈纳的一家餐厅吃了受污染的蛏子后感染了 急性胃肠炎。加泰罗尼亚自治区卫生部门对这些产品进行了追踪,并确认所有受影响的库存均已从市场上回收。 [news-c87c09218afc6c95]
塔拉戈纳营地区的一家餐厅有九人因食用蛏子而中毒。Diari ARA 报道了这一事件。 [news-5a0dd898c370f711]
加州大学圣克鲁斯分校研究人员发表的一项研究揭示了星状病毒如何利用杯状细胞的粘液分泌作为逃避 宿主 免疫并增强 传播 的退出策略。加州大学圣克鲁斯分校新闻报道了这一发现,并得到了细胞培养模型实验结果的支持。 [news-cffcfaef94ebb059]
文章报道了日本冬季 诺如病毒 食物中毒患者的数量,并援引厚生劳动省问答 A3 中的数据,指出 2025 年总病例数为 24,727 例,其中有 18,566 名患者。它还讨论了 诺如病毒 暴发 期间管理员工健康和呕吐物清理的管理指南。 [news-5198eea0aa9a8abb]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Norovirus news developments.
key_findings_en: A norovirus alert was issued following illnesses linked to frozen razor clams. Catalan authorities identified suspected batches and withdrew them, while the European alert confirmed the presence of norovirus genotypes GI and GII in the shellfish. [news-bb873d5875b587c5]

Nine diners fell ill with acute gastroenteritis after eating contaminated razor clams at a restaurant in Tarragona, Spain. The health department of the Generalitat de Catalunya traced the products and confirmed all affected stock had been recovered from the market. [news-c87c09218afc6c95]
Nine people were intoxicated by norovirus after consuming razor clams at a restaurant in the Camp de Tarragona region. The event was reported by Diari ARA. [news-5a0dd898c370f711]

A study published by UC Santa Cruz researchers revealed how astroviruses use mucus secretion from goblet cells as an exit strategy to evade host immunity and enhance transmission. This discovery was reported by the UC Santa Cruz News and supported by experimental results from cell-culture models. [news-cffcfaef94ebb059]

The article reports on the number of norovirus food poisoning patients in Japan during the winter season, citing 18,566 patients out of 24,727 total cases in 2025, as per A3 of the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's Q&A. [news-5198eea0aa9a8abb]

papers.title: Simultaneous visual detection of norovirus, rotavirus, and adenovirus using multiplex reverse transcription recombinase polymerase amplification combined with lateral flow strip.
papers.abstract: Viral gastroenteritis (VGE) poses a major threat to children's health globally, with human norovirus (NoV), rotavirus (RV), and adenovirus (AdV) as the most common causative agents. In this study, a multiplex reverse transcription recombinase polymerase amplification (mRT-RPA) detection platform combined with a lateral flow strip (LFS) enables the simultaneous detection of the RNA viruses NoV and RV and the DNA virus AdV within a single-tube reaction. The platform employs a dual-labeled primer design: forward primers are labeled with fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC), while reverse primers are conjugated with specific nucleic acid tags (NATs), enabling signal transduction and multiplex recognition via a "bridging" mechanism. The platform provides sample-to-result detection within 40 min without the need for complex instruments, making it well-suited for point-of-care testing (POCT). Using serially diluted plasmid standards, the limits of detection were determined to be 10 1 copies/μL for NoV and RV, and 10 2 copies/μL for AdV. Specificity testing demonstrated no cross-reactivity with 11 other common pathogens. In clinical validation using 64 stool samples, the platform showed complete agreement with quantitative PCR (qPCR) for all target pathogens. In conclusion, this platform provides a reliable technical tool for early diagnosis and outbreak control of VGE.

papers.title_zh: 使用多重逆转录重组酶聚合酶扩增结合侧流条同时视觉检测 诺如病毒、轮状病毒和腺病毒。
papers.source_body_en: Viral gastroenteritis (VGE) poses a major threat to children's health globally, with human norovirus (NoV), rotavirus (RV), and adenovirus (AdV) as the most common causative agents. In this study, a multiplex reverse transcription recombinase polymerase amplification (mRT-RPA) detection platform combined with a lateral flow strip (LFS) enables the simultaneous detection of the RNA viruses NoV and RV and the DNA virus AdV within a single-tube reaction. The platform employs a dual-labeled primer design: forward primers are labeled with fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC), while reverse primers are conjugated with specific nucleic acid tags (NATs), enabling signal transduction and multiplex recognition via a "bridging" mechanism. The platform provides sample-to-result detection within 40 min without the need for complex instruments, making it well-suited for point-of-care testing (POCT). Using serially diluted plasmid standards, the limits of detection were determined to be 10 1 copies/μL for NoV and RV, and 10 2 copies/μL for AdV. Specificity testing demonstrated no cross-reactivity with 11 other common pathogens. In clinical validation using 64 stool samples, the platform showed complete agreement with quantitative PCR (qPCR) for all target pathogens. In conclusion, this platform provides a reliable technical tool for early diagnosis and outbreak control of VGE.
papers.abstract_zh: 病毒性胃肠炎 (VGE) 对全球儿童健康构成重大威胁,人类 诺如病毒 (NoV)、轮状病毒 (RV) 和腺病毒 (AdV) 是最常见的病原体。在本研究中,多重逆转录重组酶聚合酶扩增(mRT-RPA)检测平台与侧流试纸条(LFS)相结合,能够在单管反应中同时检测RNA病毒NoV和RV以及DNA病毒AdV。该平台采用双标记引物设计:正向引物用异硫氰酸荧光素(FITC)标记,而反向引物与特定核酸标签(NAT)缀合,通过“桥接”机制实现信号转导和多重识别。该平台可在 40 分钟内提供从样本到结果的检测,无需复杂的仪器,非常适合即时检测 (POCT)。使用连续稀释的质粒标准品,NoV 和 RV 的检测限确定为 10 1 个拷贝/μL,AdV 的检测限为 10 2 个拷贝/μL。特异性测试表明与其他 11 种常见病原体没有交叉反应。在使用 64 个粪便样本的临床验证中,该平台显示所有目标病原体与定量 PCR (qPCR) 完全一致。综上所述,该平台为VGE的早期诊断和暴发控制提供了可靠的技术工具。

papers.title: Ligilactobacillus salivarius inhibits GII.4[P16] human norovirus replication in zebrafish larvae.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human gut bacteria can modulate human norovirus (HuNoV) infection, underscoring the need to characterize virus-bacterium interactions. This study evaluated the effect of Ligilactobacillus salivarius on HuNoV GII.4[P16] replication using a zebrafish larva model. A GII.4[P16]-positive stool specimen was resuspended in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS), centrifuged, and the supernatant stored at −80°C. salivarius was grown overnight in de Man, Rogosa, and Sharpe broth, from which bacterial cells and cell-free supernatant (CFS) were collected. The overnight broth (OB), cells, and CFS were each mixed with virus suspension at a 1:1 ratio, and 3 nL were microinjected into 3-day post-fertilization larvae; controls received PBS with virus. Daily until 4 days post-infection (dpi), 2 samples of 10 pooled larvae were collected, and RNA was extracted and quantified by droplet digital PCR. Two-way analysis of variance showed that treatment and time significantly influenced viral RNA levels ( P P = 0.051) indicating consistent inhibitory trends across the study period. CFS-injected larvae showed replication comparable to controls ( P > 0.05), peaking at 5.31 log RNA copies/larva at 1 dpi, whereas cell-containing treatments (cells and OB) significantly reduced replication ( P in vitro binding assay showed that 67% of the virus inoculum physically bound to L. In a further comparison, both live and heat-killed bacteria reduced replication initially; live L. salivarius significantly inhibited replication at 3 dpi ( P L. salivarius physically binds to HuNoV GII.4[P16] and inhibits viral replication, highlighting its potential as a probiotic intervention for HuNoV infection. IMPORTANCE Norovirus remains the leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide, responsible for nearly 700 million cases and substantial economic burden annually, yet no vaccine or antiviral therapy currently exists. This study’s findings are significant because they identify a specific probiotic strain, Ligilactobacillus salivarius , capable of directly binding to and inhibiting replication of a clinically relevant norovirus genotype (GII.4[P16]), which is responsible for many recent outbreaks globally. By demonstrating that live bacterial cells—not just secreted metabolites—drive this antiviral effect, the study points toward a mechanistic, cell-mediated mode of action that could inform targeted probiotic formulations. The use of a zebrafish larva model also offers a valuable, scalable in vivo system for studying norovirus-microbiome interactions, addressing a major bottleneck in norovirus research caused by the lack of robust cell culture systems. Together, these findings advance understanding of bacterium-virus interactions and support further development of probiotic-based strategies for preventing or reducing norovirus infection severity.

This study evaluated the effect of Ligilactobacillus salivarius on HuNoV GII.4[P16] replication using a zebrafish larva model. A GII.4[P16]-positive stool specimen was resuspended in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS), centrifuged, and the supernatant stored at −80°C. salivarius was grown overnight in de Man, Rogosa, and Sharpe broth, from which bacterial cells and cell-free supernatant (CFS) were collected. The overnight broth (OB), cells, and CFS were each mixed with virus suspension at a 1:1 ratio, and 3 nL were microinjected into 3-day post-fertilization larvae; controls received PBS with virus. Daily until 4 days post-infection (dpi), 2 samples of 10 pooled larvae were collected, and RNA was extracted and quantified by droplet digital PCR. Two-way analysis of variance showed that treatment and time significantly influenced viral RNA levels ( P P = 0.051) indicating consistent inhibitory trends across the study period. CFS-injected larvae showed replication comparable to controls ( P > 0.05), peaking at 5.31 log RNA copies/larva at 1 dpi, whereas cell-containing treatments (cells and OB) significantly reduced replication ( P in vitro binding assay showed that 67% of the virus inoculum physically bound to L. In a further comparison, both live and heat-killed bacteria reduced replication initially; live L. salivarius significantly inhibited replication at 3 dpi ( P L. salivarius physically binds to HuNoV GII.4[P16] and inhibits viral replication, highlighting its potential as a probiotic intervention for HuNoV infection. IMPORTANCE Norovirus remains the leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide, responsible for nearly 700 million cases and substantial economic burden annually, yet no vaccine or antiviral therapy currently exists. This study’s findings are significant because they identify a specific probiotic strain, Ligilactobacillus salivarius , capable of directly binding to and inhibiting replication of a clinically relevant norovirus genotype (GII.4[P16]), which is responsible for many recent outbreaks globally. By demonstrating that live bacterial cells—not just secreted metabolites—drive this antiviral effect, the study points toward a mechanistic, cell-mediated mode of action that could inform targeted probiotic formulations. The use of a zebrafish larva model also offers a valuable, scalable in vivo system for studying norovirus-microbiome interactions, addressing a major bottleneck in norovirus research caused by the lack of robust cell culture systems. Together, these findings advance understanding of bacterium-virus interactions and support further development of probiotic-based strategies for preventing or reducing norovirus infection severity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估唾液乳酸菌对人类 诺如病毒 (HuNoV) GII.4[P16] 复制的影响,因为人类肠道细菌可以调节 HuNoV 感染,这强调了表征病毒-细菌相互作用的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用斑马鱼幼虫模型来评估唾液乳酸菌对 HuNoV GII.4[P16] 复制的影响。使用GII.4[P16]阳性粪便标本作为病毒源,用与细菌治疗或对照混合的病毒悬浮液感染幼虫。
elements_zh.methods: 将病毒悬浮液与细菌 治疗 或对照以 1:1 的比例混合,并将 3 nL 显微注射到受精后 3 天的幼虫中。每天收集样本直至感染后 4 天,并使用液滴数字 PCR 定量病毒 RNA 水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 双向方差分析表明,治疗 和时间显着影响病毒 RNA 水平 (P = 0.051),表明整个研究期间的抑制趋势一致。注射 CFS 的幼虫表现出与对照相当的复制,在 1 dpi 时达到峰值 5.31 log RNA 拷贝/幼虫,而含有细胞的 治疗 显着降低了复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,唾液 Ligilactobacillus salivarius 可以抑制 HuNoV GII.4[P16] 复制,这表明益生菌对 HuNoV 感染具有潜在的干预作用。它还强调了细胞介导的作用模式,与体外结合测定不同。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持开发基于益生菌的策略来预防或减轻 诺如病毒 感染的严重程度,特别是对于导致最近许多 暴发 的 GII.4[P16] 基因型。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究使用斑马鱼模型,该模型可能无法完全代表人类生理学,并且证据基于体内观察,机械细节有限。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

papers.title: A seven-valent norovirus mRNA vaccine elicits robust humoral responses in preclinical models.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Noroviruses are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis and impose a substantial global disease burden, particularly in children younger than 5 years and in older adults. Although multiple vaccine candidates are in preclinical and clinical development, no targeted intervention has been approved. We previously reported that a pentavalent mRNA vaccine candidate encoding VP1 proteins from genotypes GI.1, GII.2, GII.3, GII.4, and GII.6 elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses in mice and nonhuman primates. Because recent surveillance data indicate increasing prevalence of GI.3 and GII.17, we designed mRNAs targeting these genotypes and evaluated an expanded seven-valent formulation in preclinical studies. We first compared candidate GI.3 and GII.17 strains in mice and selected vaccine components based on immunogenicity and cross-reactivity. The resulting seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). Importantly, incorporation of GI.3 and GII.17 broadened functional coverage, whereas multivalent formulation introduced only limited evidence of immune interference. These findings support the feasibility of surveillance-guided updating of multivalent norovirus mRNA vaccines and highlight the adaptability of the mRNA platform for addressing emerging variants. IMPORTANCE Norovirus is a major cause of vomiting and diarrhea worldwide, but developing a broadly protective vaccine is difficult because many genetically distinct strains circulate, and their prevalence changes over time. This study demonstrates a flexible vaccine strategy in which mRNA components can be selected and added based on disease surveillance and experimental evidence. We expanded a five-component norovirus vaccine to include GI.3 and GII.17, two increasingly important genotypes. The resulting seven-component vaccine generated strong antibody responses in mice and African green monkeys and broadened the range of virus types targeted by functional antibodies. Although additional studies are needed to determine whether these responses protect humans, the findings show how the adaptability of mRNA technology could support periodic updates of multivalent norovirus vaccines as circulating strains change.

papers.title: Norovirus Detection in Water Samples: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Global Evidence, Methodological Heterogeneity, and Surveillance Readiness
papers.abstract: Norovirus water monitoring may complement clinical and water-safety surveillance, but the readiness of the available evidence for routine public-health use remains unclear. We assessed the global distribution, detection patterns, methodological heterogeneity, reporting completeness, and public-health translation of molecular norovirus detection in water. We searched PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Scopus, CNKI, and Wanfang Data from database inception to June 2025. Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidance, we identified 90 eligible studies. We mapped geographic and water-system coverage, synthesized reported norovirus genogroup I/II (GI/GII) positivity using random-effects models, and evaluated methodological heterogeneity, reporting completeness, public-health linkage, and surveillance readiness. Evidence was reported from 31 countries; 87 studies were geographically mappable, yielding 92 article-country placements. Across 51 strata from 36 studies, random-effects reported a global norovirus positivity rate of 62% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 45–77%) in wastewater and 5% (95% CI: 2–17%) in groundwater; heterogeneity was substantial. In exploratory meta-regression, multi-virus assays had lower reported positivity than single-virus assays after adjustment for water type (odds ratio [OR] = 0.28; bias-reduced cluster-robust 95% CI: 0.11–0.67). Limit of detection, sensitivity, and specificity were reported by 31, 6, and 5 studies, respectively, and 3 studies reported all 3 metrics. Repeated sampling was used in 59 studies, of which 52 reported collection cadence. Twenty-nine studies linked water findings to epidemiological/community surveillance or outbreak investigation; 2 directly applied norovirus water testing in outbreak investigations, and none demonstrated prospective early warning. Five studies met the predefined full surveillance-ready reporting package. Molecular methods detected norovirus across diverse water-system contexts, but the evidence base was geographically concentrated, methodologically heterogeneous, and incompletely connected to operational public-health surveillance. Standardized sampling and analytical reporting, comparable quantitative outputs, and prospective linkage with public-health data are needed before routine implementation.

papers.title_zh: 水样中的 诺如病毒 检测:对全球证据、方法异质性和 监测 准备情况的系统回顾和荟萃分析
papers.source_body_en: Norovirus water monitoring may complement clinical and water-safety surveillance, but the readiness of the available evidence for routine public-health use remains unclear. We assessed the global distribution, detection patterns, methodological heterogeneity, reporting completeness, and public-health translation of molecular norovirus detection in water. We searched PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Scopus, CNKI, and Wanfang Data from database inception to June 2025. Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidance, we identified 90 eligible studies. We mapped geographic and water-system coverage, synthesized reported norovirus genogroup I/II (GI/GII) positivity using random-effects models, and evaluated methodological heterogeneity, reporting completeness, public-health linkage, and surveillance readiness. Evidence was reported from 31 countries; 87 studies were geographically mappable, yielding 92 article-country placements. Across 51 strata from 36 studies, random-effects reported a global norovirus positivity rate of 62% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 45–77%) in wastewater and 5% (95% CI: 2–17%) in groundwater; heterogeneity was substantial. In exploratory meta-regression, multi-virus assays had lower reported positivity than single-virus assays after adjustment for water type (odds ratio [OR] = 0.28; bias-reduced cluster-robust 95% CI: 0.11–0.67). Limit of detection, sensitivity, and specificity were reported by 31, 6, and 5 studies, respectively, and 3 studies reported all 3 metrics. Repeated sampling was used in 59 studies, of which 52 reported collection cadence. Twenty-nine studies linked water findings to epidemiological/community surveillance or outbreak investigation; 2 directly applied norovirus water testing in outbreak investigations, and none demonstrated prospective early warning. Five studies met the predefined full surveillance-ready reporting package. Molecular methods detected norovirus across diverse water-system contexts, but the evidence base was geographically concentrated, methodologically heterogeneous, and incompletely connected to operational public-health surveillance. Standardized sampling and analytical reporting, comparable quantitative outputs, and prospective linkage with public-health data are needed before routine implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 诺如病毒 水监测可以补充临床和水安全 监测,但常规公共卫生用途的现有证据是否准备就绪仍不清楚。我们评估了水中分子 诺如病毒 检测的全球分布、检测模式、方法异质性、报告完整性和公共卫生转化。我们检索了从数据库建立到 2025 年 6 月的 PubMed、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Scopus、CNKI 和万方数据。按照系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目 (PRISMA) 指南,我们确定了 90 项符合条件的研究。我们绘制了地理和水系统覆盖范围,使用随机效应模型综合了报告的 诺如病毒 基因组 I/II (GI/GII) 阳性,并评估了方法异质性、报告完整性、公共卫生联系和 监测 准备情况。31 个国家报告了证据;87 项研究可在地理上绘制地图,产生 92 篇文章所在国家/地区的位置。在 36 项研究的 51 个层次中,随机效应报告废水中的全球 诺如病毒 阳性率为 62%(95% 置信区间 [CI]:45-77%),地下水中的阳性率为 5%(95% CI:2-17%);异质性很大。在探索性荟萃回归中,在调整水类型后,多病毒检测报告的阳性率低于单病毒检测(比值比 [OR] = 0.28;偏差减少的集群稳健 95% CI:0.11–0.67)。31、6 和 5 项研究分别报告了检测限、灵敏度和特异性,其中 3 项研究报告了所有 3 个指标。59 项研究使用了重复采样,其中 52 项报告了收集节奏。29 项研究将水发现结果与流行病学/社区 监测 或 暴发 调查联系起来;2在暴发调查中直接应用诺如病毒水质检测,没有表现出前瞻性预警。五项研究符合预定义的完整 监测 就绪报告包。分子方法在不同的水系统环境中检测到 诺如病毒,但证据基础地理集中、方法异质,且与公共卫生运行 监测 不完全相关。在常规实施之前,需要标准化抽样和分析报告、可比较的定量输出以及与公共卫生数据的前瞻性联系。

papers.title: The Global Landscape of Publicly Available Norovirus Sequences: Genotype Annotations, Genome Completeness, and Geographic Representation
papers.abstract: Background: and Objectives: In the present work, we assessed genotype annotations, genome completeness, and geographic representation of norovirus in the National Center for Biotechnology Information Virus database. Methods: We analyzed metadata for 70,632 complete and partial norovirus sequence records retrieved on 17 August 2026. Major capsid protein (VP1) genotypes and RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) types were extracted from deposited annotations. Genome completeness and geographic distribution were summarized descriptively, and 55 selected complete genomes underwent phylogenetic analysis. Results: GII.4 was the most frequently annotated specific VP1 genotype (18,503 records). Specific VP1 and RdRp assignments were unavailable in the analyzed annotations for 24,804 (35.12%) and 51,892 (73.47%) records, respectively. Only 1,859 records (2.63%) were annotated as complete genomes. Country metadata were available for 65,915 records (93.32%), of which Asia contributed 56.15%. The selected phylogeny showed broad genogroup clustering, with three animal-associated genomes belonging to GIV and GVI. Conclusion: This repository snapshot identified limited complete-genome representation, incomplete typing annotations, and uneven geographic representation. These findings describe deposited records rather than population prevalence. Improved genome coverage, annotation consistency, and metadata availability could support more informative comparative analyses.

Methods: We analyzed metadata for 70,632 complete and partial norovirus sequence records retrieved on 17 August 2026. Major capsid protein (VP1) genotypes and RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) types were extracted from deposited annotations. Genome completeness and geographic distribution were summarized descriptively, and 55 selected complete genomes underwent phylogenetic analysis. Results: GII.4 was the most frequently annotated specific VP1 genotype (18,503 records). Specific VP1 and RdRp assignments were unavailable in the analyzed annotations for 24,804 (35.12%) and 51,892 (73.47%) records, respectively. Only 1,859 records (2.63%) were annotated as complete genomes. Country metadata were available for 65,915 records (93.32%), of which Asia contributed 56.15%. The selected phylogeny showed broad genogroup clustering, with three animal-associated genomes belonging to GIV and GVI. Conclusion: This repository snapshot identified limited complete-genome representation, incomplete typing annotations, and uneven geographic representation. These findings describe deposited records rather than population prevalence. Improved genome coverage, annotation consistency, and metadata availability could support more informative comparative analyses.

The researchers analyzed 70,632 sequence records, with country metadata available for 93.32% of them, predominantly from Asia. They extracted VP1 genotypes and RdRp types, noting that GII.4 was the most frequently annotated VP1 genotype. However, specific annotations were missing for a significant proportion of records. papers.abstract_zh: 背景:和目标:在目前的工作中,我们评估了国家生物技术信息中心病毒数据库中 基因组 的基因型注释、基因组 完整性和地理代表性。方法:我们分析了 2026 年 8 月 17 日检索到的 70,632 条完整和部分 诺如病毒 序列记录的元数据。从保存的注释中提取了主要衣壳蛋白 (VP1) 基因型和 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶 (RdRp) 类型。对基因组的完整性和地理分布进行描述性总结,并筛选出55个完整的基因组进行系统发育分析。结果:GII.4 是最常注释的特定 VP1 基因型(18,503 条记录)。在分析的注释中分别没有 24,804 (35.12%) 和 51,892 (73.47%) 条记录的特定 VP1 和 RdRp 分配。只有 1,859 条记录 (2.63%) 被注释为完整的 基因组。国家/地区元数据有 65,915 条记录 (93.32%),其中亚洲贡献了 56.15%。所选的 系统发育 显示出广泛的基因组聚类,其中三个动物相关的 基因组 属于 GIV 和 GVI。结论:此存储库快照识别出有限的完整 基因组 表示、不完整的打字注释和不均匀的地理表示。这些发现描述的是存放的记录而不是总体 患病率。改进的 基因组 覆盖范围、注释一致性和元数据可用性可以支持信息更丰富的比较分析。

papers.title: Enhancing pathogen detection in pediatric diarrheal stools: The case of molecular multiplexing with a real-time PCR assay.
papers.abstract: Diarrhea is a leading cause of pediatric morbidity and mortality worldwide, frequently caused by various bacterial, viral, and protozoan pathogens. Identification of these pathogens is important in clinical settings for proper management of the infection. Conventional stool culture technique is time-consuming for the detection of diarrheagenic pathogens. In addition, these traditional procedures lack sensitivity, require a specific laboratory structure, and well-trained staff. Conversely, multiplex molecular detection methods offer rapid results with less hands-on time and more sensitivity. This study compared the diagnostic performance of conventional microbiological methods and GastroFinder 2SMART multiplexed real-time PCR (real-time PCR) assay for detecting enteric pathogens in pediatric stool samples. Overall pathogen detection was significantly higher using this real-time PCR (81%) compared to the conventional assays (43.1%), reflecting differences in both sensitivity and pathogen panel breadth. Rotavirus, adenovirus, Shigella , and Giardia lamblia were frequently identified by conventional methods, whereas real-time PCR commonly detected adenovirus, Campylobacter, EPEC, ETEC, and norovirus. Certain pathogens such as Yersinia enterocolitica , Clostridioides difficile , STEC, and Dientamoeba fragilis were not tested in the conventional panel and therefore excluded for comparison. Sensitivity estimates varied, with lower sensitivity observed for EPEC, Cryptosporidium, G. lamblia , and rotavirus, partly due to the small sample numbers and wide confidence intervals. Specificity exceeded 90% for most pathogens, and diagnostic accuracy was > 90% for Shigella /EIEC, Salmonella, Cryptosporidium , Giardia lamblia , and astrovirus. Bayesian latent class analysis demonstrated the highest sensitivity for Shigella /EIEC (93.2%), followed by norovirus and adenovirus, while overall test performance, measured by the Youden Index, was greatest for Shigella /EIEC. These findings highlight the diagnostic use of real-time PCR and support its integration into routine diarrheal diagnostics to improve pathogen detection and clinical management.

papers.title_zh: 加强儿科腹泻粪便中的病原体检测:实时 PCR 检测的分子多重检测案例。
papers.source_body_en: Diarrhea is a leading cause of pediatric morbidity and mortality worldwide, frequently caused by various bacterial, viral, and protozoan pathogens. Identification of these pathogens is important in clinical settings for proper management of the infection. Conventional stool culture technique is time-consuming for the detection of diarrheagenic pathogens. In addition, these traditional procedures lack sensitivity, require a specific laboratory structure, and well-trained staff. Conversely, multiplex molecular detection methods offer rapid results with less hands-on time and more sensitivity. This study compared the diagnostic performance of conventional microbiological methods and GastroFinder 2SMART multiplexed real-time PCR (real-time PCR) assay for detecting enteric pathogens in pediatric stool samples. Overall pathogen detection was significantly higher using this real-time PCR (81%) compared to the conventional assays (43.1%), reflecting differences in both sensitivity and pathogen panel breadth. Rotavirus, adenovirus, Shigella , and Giardia lamblia were frequently identified by conventional methods, whereas real-time PCR commonly detected adenovirus, Campylobacter, EPEC, ETEC, and norovirus. Certain pathogens such as Yersinia enterocolitica , Clostridioides difficile , STEC, and Dientamoeba fragilis were not tested in the conventional panel and therefore excluded for comparison. Sensitivity estimates varied, with lower sensitivity observed for EPEC, Cryptosporidium, G. lamblia , and rotavirus, partly due to the small sample numbers and wide confidence intervals. Specificity exceeded 90% for most pathogens, and diagnostic accuracy was > 90% for Shigella /EIEC, Salmonella, Cryptosporidium , Giardia lamblia , and astrovirus. Bayesian latent class analysis demonstrated the highest sensitivity for Shigella /EIEC (93.2%), followed by norovirus and adenovirus, while overall test performance, measured by the Youden Index, was greatest for Shigella /EIEC. These findings highlight the diagnostic use of real-time PCR and support its integration into routine diarrheal diagnostics to improve pathogen detection and clinical management.
papers.abstract_zh: 腹泻是全球儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因,通常由各种细菌、病毒和原生动物病原体引起。这些病原体的鉴定对于临床环境中正确管理感染非常重要。传统的粪便培养技术对于检测致腹泻病原体来说非常耗时。此外,这些传统程序缺乏敏感性,需要特定的实验室结构和训练有素的工作人员。相反,多重分子检测方法可快速提供结果,且操作时间更少且灵敏度更高。本研究比较了传统微生物学方法和 GastroFinder 2SMART 多重实时 PCR(实时 PCR)测定法检测儿科粪便样本中肠道病原体的诊断性能。与传统检测方法 (43.1%) 相比,使用这种实时 PCR 的总体病原体检出率 (81%) 明显更高,反映了灵敏度和病原体组广度的差异。轮状病毒、腺病毒、志贺氏菌和贾第鞭毛虫经常通过常规方法鉴定,而实时PCR通常检测腺病毒、弯曲杆菌、EPEC、ETEC和诺如病毒。某些病原体,如小肠结肠炎耶尔森氏菌、艰难梭菌、STEC 和脆弱双阿米巴未在常规检测中进行测试,因此排除在比较之外。敏感性估计各不相同,观察到 EPEC、隐孢子虫、G.兰伯利亚和轮状病毒的敏感性较低,部分原因是样本数量小和置信区间宽。大多数病原体的特异性超过 90%,志贺氏菌/EIEC、沙门氏菌、隐孢子虫、贾第鞭毛虫和星状病毒的诊断准确性 > 90%。贝叶斯潜在类别分析表明,志贺氏菌 /EIEC 的灵敏度最高 (93.2%),其次是 诺如病毒 和腺病毒,而通过约登指数衡量的总体测试性能,志贺氏菌 /EIEC 最高。这些发现强调了实时 PCR 的诊断用途,并支持将其纳入常规腹泻诊断中,以改善病原体检测和临床管理。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the role of RNA structures in norovirus life cycle regulation and their potential for rational attenuation in vivo, addressing a gap in understanding how these structures influence viral fitness and immune recognition during active infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on human noroviruses, specifically Norovirus GI and GII, with an emphasis on GII.4 norovirus, to investigate the impact of RNA structures on viral functions and immune interactions.
analysis.methods: The research utilized in vitro and in vivo models to analyze norovirus RNA structures, including sequencing and structural analysis techniques, to determine their regulatory roles in the viral life cycle.
analysis.main_results: RNA structures were found to regulate multiple stages of the norovirus life cycle, including translation and replication, and their manipulation enabled rational attenuation in vivo.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that targeting norovirus RNA structures could offer a novel strategy for developing antiviral approaches, as these structures are critical for viral function and immune evasion.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of norovirus infection and highlight potential targets for therapeutic interventions, which could improve the management of norovirus gastroenteritis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on in vitro and in vivo models may limit its direct applicability to human infections, but the evidence is strong due to the detailed molecular analysis and clear experimental outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of RNA structures in norovirus life cycle regulation and their potential for rational attenuation in vivo. The research highlights the importance of these structures in controlling viral functions and immune recognition, offering a novel approach for therapeutic development. The findings suggest that targeting RNA structures could be a promising strategy for managing norovirus infections, particularly gastroenteritis. However, the study's use of in vitro and in vivo models may limit its direct relevance to human disease. The evidence is strong, supported by detailed molecular analysis and clear experimental outcomes, but further research is needed to validate these findings in clinical settings.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the role of RNA structures in norovirus life cycle regulation and their potential for rational attenuation in vivo, addressing a gap in understanding how these structures influence viral fitness and immune recognition during active infection.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study focused on human noroviruses, specifically Norovirus GI and GII, with an emphasis on GII.4 norovirus, to investigate the impact of RNA structures on viral functions and immune interactions.
analysis_en.methods: The research utilized in vitro and in vivo models to analyze norovirus RNA structures, including sequencing and structural analysis techniques, to determine their regulatory roles in the viral life cycle.
analysis_en.main_results: RNA structures were found to regulate multiple stages of the norovirus life cycle, including translation and replication, and their manipulation enabled rational attenuation in vivo.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that targeting norovirus RNA structures could offer a novel strategy for developing antiviral approaches, as these structures are critical for viral function and immune evasion.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of norovirus infection and highlight potential targets for therapeutic interventions, which could improve the management of norovirus gastroenteritis.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on in vitro and in vivo models may limit its direct applicability to human infections, but the evidence is strong due to the detailed molecular analysis and clear experimental outcomes.

papers.title: Regional and national burden and aetiological patterns of diarrhoeal disease in Asia with implications for travel medicine.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Despite the considerable burden of diarrhoeal disease in Asia, aetiology-specific patterns remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to provide a comprehensive assessment of the diarrhoeal disease burden across Asia from 1990 to 2023, focusing on the implications for travellers' diarrhoea (TD). METHODS: We estimated the burden of diarrhoeal disease in Asia, including Central, East, South, Southeast Asia and High-income Asia Pacific, across 34 countries from 1990 to 2023 using the Global Burden of Diseases Study 2023. Disease burden was calculated using age-standardized disability-adjusted life year rates (ASDRs) per 100 000 population, with 95% uncertainty intervals (UIs). Additionally, we assessed the burden attributable to risk factors and calculated pathogen-specific estimates for 13 major aetiologies. RESULTS: From 1990 to 2023, ASDRs of diarrhoeal disease declined across Asia, with the largest decline in South Asia from 9124.29 (95% UI, 7594.46-11 673.82) per 100 000 population to 1216.90 (965.73-1633.55). The decline was accompanied by reductions in cumulative aetiologic burden, particularly for rotavirus. Although norovirus was the leading aetiology in high-income Asia Pacific, rotavirus remained dominant across all other Asian regions in 2023. Burdens were concentrated among those aged < 5 years and ≥ 95 years. Among children aged < 5 years, rotavirus and adenovirus were the leading aetiologies, with adenovirus showing a particularly high age-specific DALY rate in South Asia (891.96 [484.65-1392.81] per 100 000 population). Among adults aged ≥95 years, Clostridium difficile and norovirus had the highest burdens. Sex-specific burdens were generally higher in males, except in South Asia. In 2023, unsafe water sources were the leading risk factor, especially in South Asia, 831.77 (423.32-1206.25) per 100 000 population. For viral, parasitic and gram-negative aetiologies, burdens consistently declined with increasing SDI, whereas C. difficile showed a U-shaped pattern with SDI. CONCLUSIONS: The heterogeneity in aetiology-specific burden, age- and sex-related vulnerability and associations with SDI across Asia underscores the need for destination-specific risk assessment and context-sensitive prevention strategies for TD in Asia.

papers.title: Effects of water quality, sanitation, handwashing and nutritional interventions on enteric pathogen seroconversion in rural Kenya: a cluster randomised trial
papers.abstract: Background: We evaluated whether water, sanitation, and handwashing (WASH) and nutrition interventions reduced enteric pathogen seroprevalence during the first two years of life among children in rural Kenya. Methods: We analysed the 2x2 factorial subset of the WASH Benefits Kenya cluster-randomised trial (control, WASH, nutrition, and WASH plus nutrition). Dried blood spots were collected from all children in the birth cohort after two years of intervention and at 6 and 12 months within a longitudinal substudy. Immunoglobulin G (IgG) responses were measured using a multiplex bead assay that included 12 viral, bacterial, protozoan, and helminth pathogens. The primary outcome was IgG seroprevalence at 2 years. We estimated intention-to-treat differences, comparing WASH with no WASH and nutrition with no nutrition across the factorial design. The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov ( NCT01704105 ). Findings: The primary analysis included 3030 children in 384 of 391 clusters (median age 23 months). Seroprevalence increased rapidly with age and exceeded 90% for norovirus, Campylobacter, and LT-ETEC by the final visit, with several pathogens at more moderate prevalences (24% of children were seropositive to typhoidal S. Differences between intervention groups were small: lower T. solium (−3.3 percentage points [95% CI −6.3 to −0.2]) and higher E. histolytica (3.2 [0.1 to 6.3]) with WASH versus control, and lower V. cholerae (−1.1 [−1.8 to −0.3]) and Shigella/EIEC (−2.7 [−5.5 to 0.0]) with nutrition versus no nutrition. No comparison met the 5% Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate threshold. Secondary analyses and age-seroprevalence curves suggested modest reductions in seroprevalence for some pathogens but an increase in norovirus at approximately 12 months when intervention adherence was highest. Interpretation: At the levels of adherence achieved, household-level WASH and nutrition interventions were insufficient to reduce widespread early-life enteric pathogen exposure in this high-transmission setting, supporting development of complementary vaccine and transmission-control strategies. Funding: National Institutes of Health (R01AI166671, R01AI106878, R01AI134814). The original WASH Benefits trial was funded by the Gates Foundation (OPPGD759).

analysis.summary_en: This cluster randomised trial in rural Kenya assessed the impact of water, sanitation, and handwashing (WASH) and nutrition interventions on enteric pathogen seroprevalence in children during their first two years of life. The study collected dried blood spots from children in the birth cohort and used a multiplex bead assay to measure IgG responses to 12 pathogens. The primary outcome was seroprevalence at 2 years, with intention-to-treat analyses comparing WASH with no WASH and nutrition with no nutrition. Results showed that seroprevalence increased rapidly with age, with norovirus, Campylobacter, and LT-ETEC exceeding 90% by the final visit. Intervention effects were small, with only T. solium and E. histolytica showing statistically significant differences. No comparisons met the 5% Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate threshold, and secondary analyses suggested modest reductions for some pathogens but an increase in norovirus at 12 months. The authors concluded that at the levels of adherence achieved, WASH and nutrition interventions were insufficient to reduce widespread early-life exposure to enteric pathogens, underscoring the need for complementary strategies such as vaccines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估水、卫生设施和洗手 (WASH) 以及营养干预措施是否可以减少肯尼亚农村儿童生命头两年内的肠道病原体 血清流行率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在肯尼亚农村地区进行的一项整群随机试验,涉及 384 个集群的 3030 名儿童。在一项纵向亚组研究中,干预两年后以及 6 个月和 12 个月时,从 队列研究 出生的所有儿童身上收集干血斑。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多重微珠测定法测量免疫球蛋白 G (IgG) 反应,其中包括 12 种病毒、细菌、原生动物和蠕虫病原体。主要结局是 2 年时的 IgG 血清流行率,并在析因设计中比较 WASH 与无 WASH 以及营养与无营养的情况来估计意向治疗差异。
elements_zh.main_results: 血清流行率 随着年龄的增长而迅速增加,到最后一次就诊时,诺如病毒、弯曲杆菌和 LT-ETEC 超过 90%。干预组之间的差异很小:与对照组相比,WASH 观察到较低的猪毛虫 血清流行率(−3.3 个百分点 [95% CI -6.3 至 -0.2])和较高的溶组织内阿米巴 血清流行率(3.2 [0.1 至 6.3]),以及较低的霍乱弧菌(−1.1 [−1.8 至 -0.3])和志贺菌/EIEC (−2.7 [−5.5 至 0.0]) 血清流行率 记录有营养与无营养的情况。没有任何比较达到 5% Benjamini-Hochberg 错误发现率阈值。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在达到的依从性水平上,家庭层面的 WASH 和营养干预措施不足以减少这种高 传播 环境中广泛的生命早期肠道病原体暴露,支持制定补充性 疫苗 和 传播 控制策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,虽然 WASH 和营养干预措施可能对某些病原体有一定影响,但不足以显着减少高 传播 地区的生命早期接触肠道病原体,这凸显了采取 疫苗 等其他策略的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 此外,二次分析和年龄 血清流行率 曲线表明,某些病原体的 血清流行率 略有减少,但在大约 12 个月时干预依从性最高时,诺如病毒 有所增加。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估水、卫生设施和洗手 (WASH) 以及营养干预措施是否可以减少肯尼亚农村儿童生命头两年内的肠道病原体 血清流行率。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在肯尼亚农村地区进行的一项整群随机试验,涉及 384 个集群的 3030 名儿童。在一项纵向亚组研究中,干预两年后以及 6 个月和 12 个月时,从 队列研究 出生的所有儿童身上收集干血斑。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用多重微珠测定法测量免疫球蛋白 G (IgG) 反应,其中包括 12 种病毒、细菌、原生动物和蠕虫病原体。主要结局是 2 年时的 IgG 血清流行率,并在析因设计中比较 WASH 与无 WASH 以及营养与无营养的情况来估计意向治疗差异。
analysis_zh.main_results: 血清流行率 随着年龄的增长而迅速增加,到最后一次就诊时,诺如病毒、弯曲杆菌和 LT-ETEC 超过 90%。干预组之间的差异很小:与对照组相比,WASH 观察到较低的猪毛虫 血清流行率(−3.3 个百分点 [95% CI -6.3 至 -0.2])和较高的溶组织内阿米巴 血清流行率(3.2 [0.1 至 6.3]),以及较低的霍乱弧菌(−1.1 [−1.8 至 -0.3])和志贺菌/EIEC (−2.7 [−5.5 至 0.0]) 血清流行率 记录有营养与无营养的情况。没有任何比较达到 5% Benjamini-Hochberg 错误发现率阈值。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在达到的依从性水平上,家庭层面的 WASH 和营养干预措施不足以减少这种高 传播 环境中广泛的生命早期肠道病原体暴露,支持制定补充性 疫苗 和 传播 控制策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,虽然 WASH 和营养干预措施可能对某些病原体有一定影响,但不足以显着减少高 传播 地区的生命早期接触肠道病原体,这凸显了采取 疫苗 等其他策略的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 此外,二次分析和年龄 血清流行率 曲线表明,某些病原体的 血清流行率 略有减少,但在大约 12 个月时干预依从性最高时,诺如病毒 有所增加。

papers.title: Effects of water quality, sanitation, handwashing and nutritional interventions on enteric pathogen seroconversion in rural Bangladesh: a cluster randomised trial
papers.abstract: Background: Improvements to water quality, sanitation, handwashing (WASH) and nutrition may prevent enteric pathogen infection during the first two years of life. Few randomised controlled trials have measured pathogen-specific effects of WASH and nutritional interventions. Methods: Within a 2x2 factorial cluster-randomized trial of WASH and nutritional interventions in Bangladesh, we tested dried blood spot specimens with multiplex assay for IgG responses to 12 enteric pathogens: Norovirus, Campylobacter, LT-producing enterotoxigenic E. coli (LT-ETEC), Shigella, non-typhoidal and typhoidal Salmonella enterica, Vibrio cholerae, Cryptosporidium, Giardia, Entamoeba histolytica, Taenia solium, and Strongyloides stercoralis. Primary analysis included children with IgG measurements at ~24 months, and secondary analysis assessed early effects in a sub-study at ~14 months. We estimated age-specific seroprevalence and marginal seroprevalence differences for WASH and nutrition effects. Trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov ( NCT01590095 ). Findings: Across the four arms (450 clusters), 4817 samples were tested for IgG responses, 2453 samples at the primary endpoint. Seroprevalence increased with age, consistent with intense early-life transmission. For highest transmission pathogens, >94% of children had seroconverted to norovirus, LT-ETEC and Campylobacter by 12-18 months. WASH effects were modest and pathogen-specific but generally protective. At 24 months, children that received WASH interventions had less antibody against Shigella (-4.5%, 95% CI -7.6% to -1.5%), non-typhoidal S. enterica (-4.0%, 95% CI -6.5% to -1.5%), and Giardia (-3.4%, 95% CI -6.7% to -0.2%), although not after multiple-testing correction. Nutrition had limited effects on most enteric pathogens, but reduced non-typhoidal S. enterica at 14 months (-6.4%, 95% CI: -9.8% to -3.0%). Interpretation: Multiplex serology provided evidence that WASH may modestly reduce cumulative exposure to selected enteric pathogens, but household-level interventions were insufficient to substantially disrupt transmission in this high-exposure setting. Funding: National Institutes of Health (R01AI166671, R01AI106878, R01AI134814). The original WASH Benefits trial was funded by Gates Foundation (OPPGD759).

The research aimed to address the lack of pathogen-specific evidence on WASH and nutritional interventions. A 2x2 factorial cluster-randomized trial was conducted, testing dried blood spot specimens with a multiplex assay for IgG responses to 12 enteric pathogens, including norovirus. papers.abstract_zh: 背景:改善水质、环境卫生、洗手 (WASH) 和营养可以预防生命头两年的肠道病原体感染。很少有随机对照试验测量了 WASH 和营养干预措施对病原体的特异性影响。方法:在孟加拉国进行的一项关于 WASH 和营养干预措施的 2x2 析因整群随机试验中,我们采用多重测定法测试了干血斑标本对 12 种肠道病原体的 IgG 反应:诺如病毒、弯曲杆菌、产 LT 肠毒素大肠杆菌 (LT-ETEC)、志贺氏菌、非伤寒和伤寒肠沙门氏菌、霍乱弧菌、隐孢子虫、贾第鞭毛虫、溶组织内阿米巴、猪带绦虫和粪类圆线虫。主要分析包括约 24 个月时进行 IgG 测量的儿童,二次分析评估了约 14 个月时的子研究中的早期效果。我们估计了特定年龄的 血清流行率 和边际 血清流行率 对 WASH 和营养影响的差异。试验已在 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册(NCT01590095)。结果:在四个组(450 个簇)中,对 4817 个样本进行了 IgG 反应测试,其中 2453 个样本达到了主要终点。血清流行率 随着年龄的增长而增加,与强烈的早年 传播 一致。对于最高的 传播 病原体,>94% 的儿童在 12-18 个月时血清转化为 诺如病毒、LT-ETEC 和弯曲杆菌。WASH 效果适中且具有病原体特异性,但总体上具有保护性。24 个月时,接受 WASH 干预的儿童针对志贺氏菌(-4.5%,95% CI -7.6% 至 -1.5%)、非伤寒肠沙门氏菌(-4.0%,95% CI -6.5% 至 -1.5%)和贾第鞭毛虫(-3.4%,95% CI -6.7% 至 -0.2%)的抗体较低,尽管经过多次测试后情况并非如此修正。营养对大多数肠道病原体的影响有限,但在 14 个月时减少了非伤寒沙门氏菌(-6.4%,95% CI:-9.8% 至 -3.0%)。解释:Multiplex 血清学 提供的证据表明,WASH 可能会适度减少对选定肠道病原体的累积暴露,但家庭层面的干预措施不足以在这种高暴露环境中显着破坏 传播。资助:美国国立卫生研究院(R01AI166671、R01AI106878、R01AI134814)。最初的 WASH Benefits 试验由盖茨基金会 (OPPGD759) 资助。

papers.title: Acute Intestinal Infections in Children Aged 1–5 in Developed and Developing Countries
papers.abstract: Acute intestinal infections remain one of the leading causes of morbidity among children under five years of age and represent an important public health challenge in both developed and developing countries. Although these infections often share similar clinical manifestations, their etiological structure, severity, diagnostic accessibility, treatment approaches, and prevention strategies differ considerably depending on socioeconomic conditions, sanitation, healthcare infrastructure, and vaccination coverage. Aim: This review aims to summarize current data on the epidemiology, etiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of acute intestinal infections in children aged 1–5 years, as well as to provide a comparative analysis of approaches in countries with different income levels. Effective prevention and control require context-specific strategies combining high vaccination coverage, improved water, sanitation and hygiene, timely pathogen-specific diagnosis, rational antimicrobial use, and strengthened surveillance, with particular priority given to high-burden and resource-limited settings.

papers.title: Viral pathogens in effluent samples collected from a swine slaughterhouse in Central Italy: a 1-year molecular surveillance
papers.abstract: Introduction Molecular screening for zoonotic and species-specific viral pathogens in environmental samples is essential for obtaining epidemiological data to support risk-based assessments in the food industry, particularly in settings such as slaughterhouses. Methods This study screened 72 effluent specimens collected between January and December 2025 from two sites within a domestic pig slaughterhouse in Central Italy: the stocking yard (V1) and the wastewater treatment plant (WWTP; V2). The viruses investigated were astrovirus, hepatitis A virus, hepatitis E virus (HEV), norovirus (NoV), and rotavirus (RV). Viral detection was performed using real-time reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and nested reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) assays, followed by phylogenetic analysis. Results The results showed that ribonucleic acid (RNA) from at least one of the target viruses was detected in 37.50% of the specimens, with HEV3-c detected in 26.39%, NoV-GII.3 in 12.50%, and NoV-GI.4 in 9.72%. Among the positive effluent samples, 62.96% were collected at V1 and 37.04% at V2. Samples from V1 exhibited higher viral loads, with HEV RNA levels reaching (105) genome equivalents per milliliter (GE/mL) and NoV-GI and NoV-GII RNA levels reaching (103) GE/mL, compared with (103) GE/mL for HEV RNA and (101) GE/mL for NoV-GI and NoV-GII RNA in samples from V2. Discussion The detection of viral RNA sequences both before and after WWTP treatment highlights scientific and regulatory concerns regarding the potential dissemination of zoonotic and species-specific viruses into the environment. Regulatory gaps in the management and monitoring of these environmental matrices underscore the importance of multidisciplinary approaches to addressing this One Health issue.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介 对环境样本中的人畜共患和物种特异性病毒病原体进行分子筛查对于获取流行病学数据以支持食品行业基于风险的评估至关重要,特别是在屠宰场等环境中。方法 本研究筛选了 2025 年 1 月至 12 月期间从意大利中部一家家猪屠宰场内的两个地点收集的 72 个污水样本:养猪场 (V1) 和废水 治疗 工厂 (WWTP;V2)。研究的病毒为星状病毒、甲型肝炎病毒、戊型肝炎病毒(HEV)、诺如病毒(NoV)和轮状病毒(RV)。使用实时逆转录定量聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)和巢式逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)检测进行病毒检测,然后进行系统发育分析。结果结果显示,37.50%的标本中检测到至少一种目标病毒的核糖核酸(RNA),其中HEV3-c占26.39%,NoV-GII.3占12.50%,NoV-GI.4占9.72%。在阳性流出物样品中,62.96%在V1处收集,37.04%在V2处收集。V1 的样品表现出更高的病毒载量,HEV RNA 水平达到每毫升 (105) 基因组 当量 (GE/mL),NoV-GI 和 NoV-GII RNA 水平达到 (103) GE/mL,而 V2 样品中的 HEV RNA 为 (103) GE/mL,NoV-GI 和 NoV-GII RNA 为 (101) GE/mL。讨论 在污水处理厂 治疗 之前和之后对病毒 RNA 序列的检测突出了对人畜共患和物种特异性病毒可能传播到环境中的科学和监管担忧。这些环境矩阵的管理和监测方面的监管差距凸显了采用多学科方法来解决这一“同一个健康”问题的重要性。

analysis_zh.main_results: 在 37.50% 的样本中检测到至少一种目标病毒的 RNA,其中检测到 HEV3-c 占 26.39%,NoV-GII.3 占 12.50%,NoV-GI.4 占 9.72%。V1 样本表现出更高的病毒载量,HEV RNA 水平达到每毫升 105 基因组 当量 (GE/mL),NoV-GI 和 NoV-GII RNA 水平达到 103 GE/mL,而 V2 样本中的 HEV RNA 为 103 GE/mL,NoV-GI 和 NoV-GII RNA 为 101 GE/mL。

papers.title: Comparative inactivation of Tulane virus on fresh iceberg lettuce using oxidizing sanitizers and pulsed light
papers.abstract: Human norovirus (HuNoV) is the leading viral cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide and is frequently associated with foodborne outbreaks linked to fresh produce, particularly to leafy greens. This study provides a comparative evaluation of the efficacy of two oxidizing sanitizers widely used in the fresh produce industry, peracetic acid (PAA), sodium hypochlorite and the non-thermal physical treatment pulsed light (PL), for the inactivation of viruses on iceberg lettuce. Lettuce samples were spot-inoculated with Tulane virus (TuV), a cultivable HuNoV surrogate, and exposed to chemical sanitizers for 90 s at different concentrations (chlorine: 50, 100, and 200 ppm; PAA: 40, 80, and 160 ppm) or to PL at fluences ranging from 1.44 to 11.52 J/cm 2 . The effect of these treatments on lettuce color, weight, and texture was also assessed. For chemical treatments, no statistically significant differences in viral reduction were observed among concentrations (p > 0.05), with average reductions of 1.7 log 10 for PAA and 2.2 log 10 for chlorine. In contrast, PL treatment achieved substantially higher levels of viral inactivation (∼ 5 log 10 reduction) across all fluences tested. Sequential application of PL (1.44 J/cm 2 ) followed by either sodium hypochlorite (50 ppm) or PAA (40 ppm) did not result in additional viral reduction, indicating a limited benefit of combined treatments under the experimental conditions used in this study. Overall, these findings demonstrate that PL is effective at inactivating surface-associated TuV on fresh-cut iceberg lettuce under controlled conditions, while chemical sanitizers provide more limited reductions, however, confirmation using infectious HuNoV systems would be required. These results provide practical insights for fresh produce sanitation strategies, while highlighting important limitations related to surface accessibility, matrix effects, and the use of a surrogate virus.

papers.full_text: Abstract The Department of War Serum Repository (DOWSR, formerly DODSR 1 ) was established in 1989 after the initiation in 1985 of the U.S. Department of War’s universal mandatory human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) screening program. DOWSR, which is currently maintained by the Armed Forces Health Surveillance Division (AFHSD), preserves over 78 million serum specimens. Similar to a study that investigated research conducted from 1985 through 2012 utilizing the serum repository, this study evaluated DOWSR specimen availability, stratified by demographic variables, and conducted an analysis to determine total number and types of research studies performed using the DOWSR from 2013 through 2024. Two methods were employed: a structured PubMed search and an exhaustive online search based on records of requests for serum samples from AFHSD. Results show that the focus of DOWSR’s research within the past decade has increased, especially in regulatory molecules, autoimmune indicators, and microRNA expression patterns, with increases in both the number of sponsored studies and variety of analytes investigated. Changes in the types of studies pursued by DOWSR research may reflect changing trends in funded research regarding health concerns for service members and veterans. MethodsData on serum specimens through the end of 2024 were obtained from DMSS. Serum availability was stratified by sex, age, and branch of service. Serum samples were not accessed; only data on the availability of specimens were utilized. To determine the total number of publications using DOWSR serum samples, the authors conducted a review of internal, controlled-access AFHSD records, and of external public records. First, external publicly accessible scientific literature in the PubMed database was queried using the following text string: “department of defense biorepository”, “dod biorepository”, “DoDSR”, “dodsr”, “dod serum repository”, “dod sr”, “Department of Defense Serum Repository (DoDSR)”, “Armed Forces Health Surveillance Center” (and “Branch” and “Division”), “Department of Defense Serum Repository”, “military”, “dod”, “defense” and “biorepository*”, “repositor*”, “ stored”, “storage”, “bank”, and “frozen”—in English. There were 349 publications initially identified, which the researchers then restricted by the additional criteria: research studies conducted by or for the U.S. military as identified by known authors, sponsors, and institutions, confirmed use of DOWSR samples in the paper’s methodology, and publication status within the study period, 2013-2024. 100 of the 349 externally identified studies met all inclusion criteria (Figure 1) . FIGURE 1.Department of War Serum Repository Results in Literature Search Using Both Alogrithmic and Intense MethodsThis flowchart details the methodology for identifying published studies that used samples from the Department of War Serum Repository (DOWSR). The purpose is to show how an initial broad search was systematically narrowed down to a final number of included publications. The process began with two parallel searches: a PubMed search that initially identified 349 publications and a search of internal AFHSD records for 164 serum requests. After screening and removing duplicates, 100 studies remained from the PubMed search. An additional exhaustive search of PubMed, DTIC, and other sources for the 164 internal requests yielded another 12 unique, published studies. Combining these results led to a final total of 112 publications included in the review.The second part of the analysis was an internal search utilizing a list of serum-based studies queried at AFHSD that were supported from 2013 through 2024. The DOWSR management database tool and research protocol review tracker are record management systems implemented to manage and track all research and serum studies supported by AFHSD. According to their records, 164 unique serum requests were completed and provided to their requesters during the study period.Additionally, for each DOWSR request, the names of the investigators and health condition(s) under study were searched first in PubMed, then if not found, in Google, then, finally, in the Defense Technical Information Center (DTIC); DTIC is an organization within the U.S. Department of War (DOW) that serves as a central repository for scientific and technical records, including reports and both published and unpublished research. In each search, the full title, list of authors, then combination of partial title and author list were queried, with results reviewed for a match with internal records. This exhaustive search method identified an additional 12 articles that used DOWSR specimens and were published from 2013 through 2024. These record searches resulted in a combined total of 112 published studies. A systematic literature review then determined the analyte(s) and health condition(s) investigated, methodology, and significance of findings. Neither a meta-analysis nor any other statistical analyses were performed, nor were there any a priori decisions for inclusion based on study design. When possible, health outcomes were categorized based on the groupings defined in the previous study, 2 for ease of comparison, as was the case for 8 categories. Otherwise, categories were classified by the authors (for cases of burn pit exposure, osteoporosis, cardiovascular disease, tobacco use, deployment exposures; (Table 4) . This classification was based on the main outcome or, for studies without clear outcomes, exposure investigated. This approach was necessary chiefly to account for the emergence of exposure-focused studies, without defined outcomes, that did not conform to the previously established categories. Supplementary Materials What are the new findings?This review identified 112 published and 21 non-published studies that used DOWSR sera during the study period. Of the published 112 studies, 30 investigated infectious diseases, 25 investigated autoimmune disorders, 13 investigated neoplasms, and 11 investigated chronic metabolic outcomes. More studies using DOWSR specimens were published on environmental exposures and autoimmune disorders compared to prior years. ResultsContents of the DOWSR At the end of this study’s surveillance period, December 31, 2024, the DOWSR contained just under a total of 78.6 million samples. The exclusion of unavailable samples and those without identifiable or demographic information resulted in 61.9 million samples from 11.4 million distinct service members. After the exclusion of samples with erroneous or outlier information (e.g., missing age, younger than age 17 years or older than age 70 years at collection, outlier SSNs with the top 0.01% serum sample counts, n=1,112), 61.3 million (78.1%) of the serum samples were available for researchers, from 11.1 million members, with an average age of 27.7 years (standard deviation [SD] 8.64, median 25) at time of serum collection. There was a mean of 5.5 samples per person (SD 4.75, median 4), with a mean of 1.4 years between sample collections (SD 1.32, median 1), and a mean range from first to last sample per person of 6.3 years (SD 6.79, median 4) (Table 1) . Among the 61.3 million samples that met the inclusion criteria, contributors were mostly male (77.9%) and served in the Army (41.0)% (data not shown). The annual number of serum samples provided to the DOWSR steadily increased from 1985 to its peak in 2003 (n=2.3 million), then remained relatively stable until 2010, after which it slowly started to decrease to 1.3 million samples at the end of 2024 (Figure 2) . The purpose is to illustrate the trend in specimen collection volume over time. The number of collected specimens shows a steady increase from the program's inception, rising from less than half a million in 1985 to a peak of approximately 2.3 million specimens in 2003. After 2003, the annual collection volume remained relatively stable at around 2 million per year until 2010, after which it began a gradual decline to approximately 1.3 million specimens by 2024. Figure 3 shows the distribution of age at time of serum collection for service members ages 17-70 years. 21-year-olds contributed the highest number of serum samples (n=4.1 million, 6.8%). From 21 years of age, serum contribution decreased with increasing age (Figure 3) . Service members who were younger than age 30 years contributed 68.6% of all serum specimens during the surveillance period, while those older than age 50 years contributed only 1.7% of serum samples (Figure 3) . full_text_sections.discussion: Discussion In 1997, the DOWSR began expanding from being chiefly an instrument of the DOW HIV program to support a wider mission of broader health surveillance and identifying, preventing, and controlling service-linked illnesses. 28 , 30 It is no surprise that the variety of study topics has continued to increase since inception. The total number of studies and analytes investigated increased from 57 distinct analytes within 76 studies from 1985 to 2012 2 to 65 analytes within 112 studies from 2013 to 2024. This study noted several differences in the types of analytes and health exposures or outcomes assessed by investigators since the last review of DOWSR-supported publications in 2015. 2 In particular, the number of studies analyzing regulatory molecules, miRNAs, and autoantibodies increased. Although the leading investigational outcomes (e.g., infectious disease, autoimmune disorders, neoplasms) were the same in both periods, this study indicates that in the past decade attention within those outcome categories shifted. In addition, studies investigating chronic metabolic conditions, physical injuries, and deployment-related exposures increased. Reflecting the initial goal of the DOWSR, sexually transmitted infections (including HIV and herpes) had previously been the most popular infectious disease study topic. 2 In 2013-2024, focus of infectious disease research shifted to respiratory infections (including influenza and SARS-CoV2) and to a wide array of vectorborne diseases including leishmaniasis and rickettsia (Table 3) . Increasingly prevalent studies on arboviruses and vector-borne pathogens may reflect changes in operational deployments in areas with higher risk and spread of vector-borne diseases within the U.S. and abroad. There was a slight increase in the number of studies published on autoimmune disorders compared to the prior review, with rheumatoid arthritis biomarkers representing a large proportion of these studies (n=3 previously, increased to n=8). 2 The DOW Peer Reviewed Medical Research Program has funded arthritis research since 2009, and the Fiscal Year 2024 National Defense Authorization Act established a standalone Arthritis Research Program under the Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP), which will likely continue to increase the number of these DOWSR-supported biomarker studies. 32 As the world’s largest serum repository, and with a chronology exceeding 20 years for many individuals, the DOWSR contains pre-diagnostic data for many individuals who have developed rare cancers. This is a well-suited resource to the risk factor analyses increasingly performed for cancer studies. Increased neoplasm research has likely been fueled by the cancer “moonshot” initiatives of 2016 and 2022, which sought to engage private and public resources and expertise to accelerate development of cancer treatments, diagnostics, and prevention. 33 Research projects led by the Murtha Cancer Center 26 helped advocate for increased cancer research related to military exposures through the Framingham and Project for Military Exposures and Toxin History Evaluation in US service members (PROMETHEUS) initiatives. The trends seen in this review—an increase from the original review’s 11 studies targeting neoplasms within 27 years to 13 studies within 11 years—correlate with the broader priorities of those initiatives and emphasize the growing utilization of the DOWSR for oncological research. Studies on burn pit and other environmental or deployment-related exposures became more common following the 2016 publication of the Journal of Occupational and Environmental Medicine , 29 which highlighted deployment exposures, biomarkers, and health outcomes studies utilizing specimens from the DOWSR; there was only a single burn pit study from 1985 to 2012, compared to 8 from 2013 to 2024. 2 Many environmental exposure studies are linked to concerns about exposures at specific bases, such as radioactive, heavy metal, pesticide, and PFAS. These studies have become more common following passage of the Sergeant First Class Heath Robinson Honoring Our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics (PACT) Act of 2022, which mandated that the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and other federal agencies conduct new health and exposure research studies. 24 The PACT Act also helped establish the VA ‘presumption of exposure’ policy, which assumes that veterans who served in specific locations during certain periods of time were exposed to the harmful chemicals used (with Agent Orange an explicit example); this reduces the burden of proof for veterans seeking care. 24 Further, the CDMRP has expanded over the past decade, funding research into numerous conditions affecting service members including toxic exposures. 25 Research using the presumptive exposure model may become more common in DOWSR studies, with increased veterans’ advocacy to understand exposure associations with health outcomes, and as laboratory methods for metabolomic and genomic studies improve. The primary limitation of this study is that investigators were not systemically contacted, which means it was possible for some studies to have been missed in this review, particularly studies with ‘negative’ or inconclusive findings, as those are less likely to be published. In addition, abstracts were not included in this review. Because AFHSD tracks all requests for serum as part of its record management systems, it is unlikely that a significant number of published studies are missing from this review, however.Findings from this review of studies published from 2013 through 2024 indicate that DOW researchers and public health professionals have continued to utilize the DOWSR to enhance military readiness by contributing to the etiological understanding of debilitating conditions, as well as providing important information to improve our understanding of the spread of infectious diseases. The DOWSR is a crucial resource for maintaining a healthy and deployable force. Its importance lies in its ability for researchers and public health personnel to efficiently and retrospectively analyze emergent pathogens, novel exposures, and previously unrecognized health threats to inform risk assessments and validate force health protection measures.
full_text_sections.other: What is the impact on readiness and force health protection?To inform risk assessments and validate force health protection measures, researchers and public health professionals use the DOWSR to retrospectively analyze emergent pathogens, exposures, and unrecognized health threats. This medical surveillance and research each enhances military readiness by improving understanding of debilitating conditions that affect service members, such as autoimmune and infectious diseases, neoplasms, and chronic metabolic conditions. Contents of the DOWSR At the end of this study’s surveillance period, December 31, 2024, the DOWSR contained just under a total of 78.6 million samples. The exclusion of unavailable samples and those without identifiable or demographic information resulted in 61.9 million samples from 11.4 million distinct service members. After the exclusion of samples with erroneous or outlier information (e.g., missing age, younger than age 17 years or older than age 70 years at collection, outlier SSNs with the top 0.01% serum sample counts, n=1,112), 61.3 million (78.1%) of the serum samples were available for researchers, from 11.1 million members, with an average age of 27.7 years (standard deviation [SD] 8.64, median 25) at time of serum collection. There was a mean of 5.5 samples per person (SD 4.75, median 4), with a mean of 1.4 years between sample collections (SD 1.32, median 1), and a mean range from first to last sample per person of 6.3 years (SD 6.79, median 4) (Table 1) . papers.title_original: A New Era of Research in the U.S. Department of War Serum Repository: A Review of Published Studies, 2013–2024

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on human noroviruses and human disease, specifically examining norovirus genogroups/variants and their association with norovirus gastroenteritis. The central question is to assess the research trends and findings related to norovirus and its impact on human health.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes a structured PubMed search and an exhaustive online search based on records of requests for serum samples from AFHSD. No meta-analysis or statistical analyses were performed, and there were no a priori decisions for inclusion based on study design. The review combined external and internal search methods to identify 112 published studies that utilized specimens from the DOWSR.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that the focus of DOWSR’s research has increased in recent years, particularly in regulatory molecules, autoimmune indicators, and microRNA expression patterns. It also notes that more studies using DOWSR specimens were published on environmental exposures and autoimmune disorders compared to prior years. Additionally, it shows that serum samples from younger service members (under 30 years) were more frequently used in studies, with a significant portion of samples coming from individuals aged 21 years.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report any controversies or evidence gaps directly. However, it notes that the exclusion of samples with erroneous or outlier information resulted in a significant reduction in the number of samples available for analysis, which may affect the comprehensiveness of findings. The review also does not provide detailed information on the specific mechanisms of norovirus infection or its differential diagnosis compared to other pathogens.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on understanding the role of regulatory molecules, microRNA expression patterns, and environmental exposures in norovirus-related diseases. It also highlights the need for more detailed studies on the mechanisms of norovirus infection and its impact on autoimmune disorders, as well as the importance of maintaining a diverse and representative sample collection for comprehensive research.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the research trends and findings related to human noroviruses and norovirus gastroenteritis using specimens from the Department of War Serum Repository (DOWSR). The review highlights an increase in studies focusing on regulatory molecules, autoimmune indicators, and microRNA expression patterns over the past decade. It also notes that more studies have investigated environmental exposures and autoimmune disorders. The majority of serum samples were collected from younger service members, with those under 30 contributing significantly to the research. The review does not report controversies or evidence gaps but suggests future research should explore the mechanisms of norovirus infection and its impact on autoimmune conditions, as well as the role of environmental factors in disease progression.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注人类 诺如病毒 和人类疾病,特别检查 诺如病毒 基因组/变异及其与 诺如病毒 胃肠炎的关联。核心问题是评估与 诺如病毒 相关的研究趋势和发现及其对人类健康的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据库包括结构化 PubMed 搜索和基于 AFHSD 血清样本请求记录的详尽在线搜索。没有进行荟萃分析或统计分析,也没有根据研究设计预先决定是否纳入。该审查结合了外部和内部检索方法,确定了 112 项已发表的研究,这些研究使用了 DOWSR 的样本。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该评论强调,近年来 DOWSR 的研究重点有所增加,特别是在调节分子、自身免疫指标和 microRNA 表达模式方面。它还指出,与前几年相比,发表了更多关于环境暴露和自身免疫性疾病的使用 DOWSR 标本的研究。此外,它还表明,研究中更频繁地使用来自年轻军人(30 岁以下)的血清样本,其中很大一部分样本来自 21 岁的个体。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查不直接报告任何争议或证据差距。然而,它指出,排除含有错误或异常信息的样本会导致可用于分析的样本数量显着减少,这可能会影响研究结果的全面性。该综述也没有提供有关 诺如病毒 感染的具体机制或其与其他病原体相比的差异的详细信息。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议未来的研究应侧重于了解调节分子、microRNA 表达模式和环境暴露在 诺如病毒 相关疾病中的作用。它还强调需要对 诺如病毒 感染的机制及其对自身免疫性疾病的影响进行更详细的研究,以及维持多样化和代表性样本收集以进行综合研究的重要性。

news.content: About Last news Culture Celebrities Politics Weather & Nature Events Interesting Madrid Catalonia Valencia Andalusia Regions Last news Culture Celebrities Politics Weather & Nature Events Interesting facts Madrid Catalonia Valencia Andalusia All locations About RUSSPAIN.com Search ESC Search Popular topics: Culture Politics Celebrities Madrid Catalonia Andalusia Spanish News / News / Norovirus alert follows illnesses linked to frozen razor clams News Norovirus alert follows illnesses linked to frozen razor clams By Richard Reid • November 3, 2026, 3:27 AM • ⏱ 2 mins read Norovirus alert follows illnesses linked to frozen razor clams © russpain.com Several people fell ill after eating frozen razor clams in Tarragona, prompting a European food-safety alert. Catalan authorities say suspected batches have been identified and withdrawn; tests found GI and GII norovirus. The European alert reports a positive result for genetic material from norovirus genotypes GI and GII, although the permitted level is zero. The positive test came from frozen razor clams from Spain linked to a restaurant in Camp de Tarragona. Health services sampled two lots of frozen razor clams held by the establishment. According to reporting published on 2 November, nine diners developed acute gastroenteritis after eating the razor clams in early September. The shellfish was reportedly insufficiently cooked. Spain reported the incident through the EU Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed (RASFF) on 28 October 2026 under notification 2026.9600, classifying the risk as serious. Catalan health authorities traced the operators involved in distribution, then said all affected stock found on the market had been recovered. The measure was to withdraw the implicated product. RASFF is the European Union’s Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed, which national authorities use to share information about food and feed risks requiring rapid action. Norovirus commonly causes outbreaks of foodborne illness. Infection can lead to gastroenteritis, with vomiting and diarrhoea among its symptoms. Dehydration is a particular danger for young children and older people. Symptoms usually begin 12 to 48 hours after infection and last between one and three days in most cases. The virus can spread through direct contact with an infected person or a contaminated surface. Contaminated food is another route of transmission. Norovirus infections occur worldwide throughout the year, with activity peaking in winter in temperate climates.
